title: An NMR insight into the solvatochromic behaviour of Brooker's merocyanine dyes
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,25436-25440
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA03758A, Paper

Michal Afri, Hugo E. Gottlieb, Natalia Fridman, Abed Saady
Solvent polarity modulates colour and electronic structure in Brooker’s merocyanine dyes. NMR/UV-Vis data correlate with ET(30), revealing shifts in zwitterionic and vinylogous amide character—guiding design of responsive chromophores.
